text:
Zoe: New micro-challenge idea: "Espresso + 20 squats" at 12:20 today. One espresso (or matcha) then 20 air squats. Winner = best form + clap count. :coffee::leg: 
Marco: I will lose but will still clap like I won. Also what counts as "best form"? Deep squat >90deg? :thinking_face: 
Jillian: Deep squat with heels down and chest up. I will judge. No cheating by doing tiny pulses. :eyes: 
Ty: Bet: winner gets to choose Friday's playlist. Loser brings empanadas. :musical_note::empanada: 
Zoe: Deal. Empanada stakes = high. @facilities-bot can you put a 12:20 reminder? 
facilities-bot: Event created: "Espresso Squat Micro" — 12:20 today. Location: breakout by windows. Max 8 participants. Optional.
Marco: Also can we have a tiny leaderboard? I propose we scribble times on the whiteboard and tally reps. 
Jillian: I'll bring a chalk marker. Also filming allowed for slow-mo form critique. Consent required. :camera:
Ty: GIF for motivation: https://giphy.com/gifs/squats-nyc-3o6ZsYxQxjhJZrjZta — please enjoy. 
Emma: RSVP: count me in. I will probably turn squat into a dramatic interpretive dance. 
Zoe: RSVP: in. Bringing a moka pot alternative for non-espresso humans. 
Marco: RSVP: in (I will clap convincingly). 
Jillian: RSVP: in (head judge). 
Ty: RSVP: in (referee and empanada financier). 
Zoe: Quick rule addendum: no bouncing at the bottom, full extension at top, and a single synchronized clap after the 20th rep counts as bonus spirit points. Judges' votes final. 
Jillian: I'll judge form and spirit. If tie, we do a tie-breaker: 10 one-legged pistols (or until someone cries). 
facilities-bot: Note: please leave the breakout tidy. Facilities warns that floor can be slippery if coffee spills.
Marco: I'll bring towels and I solemnly swear not to espresso-splash. 
Zoe: See you at 12:20. May the best butt win. :peach:
